review: Maneuver and posture summary rows and range/sense continuation transcribed. Detailed combat, tactical transitions, movement rounding and interruption contracts remain pending.

entries.acceptance: A combatant selects one maneuver per turn. Extra attacks or defenses modify that maneuver's legal effects; they do not implicitly grant another full turn.
aim: defense eligibility any, with possible loss of aim; movement step. Accumulate ranged accuracy under actual weapon/target conditions.
all-out-attack: defense eligibility none; movement half movement. Use the selected bonus or multiple-attack option; forfeit active defense.
all-out-defense: defense eligibility any; movement option-dependent. Select +2 to one defense type or two defenses against each attack; retain detailed compatibility rules.
attack: defense eligibility any; movement step. Make an eligible unarmed or weapon attack.
posture: defense eligibility any; movement none. Change posture through its specific transition rules.
concentrate: defense eligibility any, with possible disruption; movement step. Advance an actual mental task and check interruption when appropriate.
idle: defense eligibility any, at -4 while stunned; movement none. Take no action and perform the eligible stun-recovery procedure.
evaluate: defense eligibility any; movement step. Evaluate a specific melee opponent.
feint: defense eligibility any; movement step. Resolve a feint against a specific opponent without treating it as ordinary injury.
move-attack: defense eligibility dodge or block, no parry under summary; movement full movement. Combine legal movement and the penalized attack, retaining detailed restrictions.
move: defense eligibility any; movement full movement. Move without an independent attack or ready action.
ready: defense eligibility any; movement step. Perform a specific item preparation or manipulation.
wait: defense eligibility any; movement trigger-dependent. Reserve a declared response for an actual trigger; do not execute both the wait and a second unrestricted maneuver.

standing: melee attack +0, active defense +0, ranged torso/groin/leg targeting +0; normal, with sprint eligibility. Posture does not itself penalize ranged attack skill. Apply detailed visibility and anatomy restrictions.

crouching: melee attack -2, active defense +0, ranged torso/groin/leg targeting -2; two-thirds normal movement, adding one-half movement point per hex. Posture does not itself penalize ranged attack skill. Apply detailed visibility and anatomy restrictions.

kneeling: melee attack -2, active defense -2, ranged torso/groin/leg targeting -2; one-third movement, adding two movement points per hex. Posture does not itself penalize ranged attack skill. Apply detailed visibility and anatomy restrictions.

crawling: melee attack -4, active defense -3, ranged torso/groin/leg targeting -2; one-third movement, adding two movement points per hex; only close-reach melee attacks. Posture does not itself penalize ranged attack skill. Apply detailed visibility and anatomy restrictions.

sitting: melee attack -2, active defense -2, ranged torso/groin/leg targeting -2; no movement. Posture does not itself penalize ranged attack skill. Apply detailed visibility and anatomy restrictions.

lying: melee attack -4, active defense -3, ranged torso/groin/leg targeting -2; one yard per second. Posture does not itself penalize ranged attack skill. Apply detailed visibility and anatomy restrictions.
A crawling or lying human occupies two tactical hexes. Posture changes must validate actual occupied spaces; the human footprint does not override every creature body form.

Against a crawling/lying target, an attacker at equal or lower elevation farther away than the attacker's own height sees only half the torso (-2) and cannot target groin, legs or feet. If the target also lowers its head, neck, eyes and face are unavailable. Do not stack a second identical torso-exposure penalty.
For each yard the target is above the shooter, add one yard to effective range before lookup; retain actual height and ground-distance measurements.
For each two yards the shooter is above the target, subtract one yard from effective range, but not below half the ground distance. Apply the detailed arithmetic precision policy.

For sense or sensor-operation checks using this table, subtract speed from range with a minimum of zero, rather than adding speed as in fast-target shooting. Sensor-specific exceptions remain applicable.
